name: io.github.limuzi013/autocad-mcp
title: AutoCAD MCP
description: Drives a running AutoCAD 2026 session over its ActiveX/COM API, in millimetres and degrees

environmentVariables.name: ACAD_MCP_OUTPUT_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Written DWG/DXF files are restricted to this directory; save_drawing_as refuses paths outside it.

environmentVariables.name: ACAD_MCP_TYPELIB
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the ActiveX type-library location. Otherwise the newest acax*.tlb under the Autodesk Shared directory is used.
